session_concurrency.definition: --concurrency N = N live session TREES (root + every descendant subagent). A slot is released only when the whole tree drains; then the lane recycles with a fresh session from turn 0. Subagents share the parent's slot, so in-flight HTTP requests can exceed N.
session_concurrency.cli_help_caveat: The generic --concurrency help text still says 'concurrent requests'; agentic replay overrides that meaning.

evidence.quote: ``--concurrency N`` means N such trees live at any instant.

Exactly one session slot per live tree, released exactly once, when the tree DRAINS: the root has sent its terminal turn (``root_pending`` cleared) AND every descendant has terminally completed (``outstanding == 0``).
So the instantaneous in-flight request count can exceed N during fan-out bursts; the steady population of independent sessions is N.
Number of concurrent requests to maintain.
